name: kobig
description: Personal Claude Code harness, packaged as an installable plugin.

plugins.name: kbg
plugins.description: Personal Claude Code harness: 32 senior-specialist agents (incl. ideate-critic fresh-context critic for /ideate + typescript-reviewer/python-reviewer/go-reviewer language-specific bug-class reviewers for /review-pr multi-agent chain), 28 workflow skills (incl. decide for the Judgment Ladder + probe/strategize/debate lenses, incident for chaotic/time-pressed stabilization with embedded hotfix path, harness-audit for deterministic fleet/schema/structural audit with --health and --coverage modes, harness-nav L3 escape hatch for capability discovery, learn for human-gated session-pattern capture), 13 commands (incl. /frame for loading a dev/review/research working-frame, /ideate for explicit divergent-ideation trigger with SessionStart frame-rotation + daily-budget advisory, /ideate-search for qmd-backed recall, /deep-dive for research briefs, /ship-task for the full 9-step senior-engineer loop with embedded acceptance gating, /ship-merge + /ship-release, /fix-bug, /address-review, /post-mortem, /status-update, /dismiss-stale, /kbg-help), governance hooks across 14 lifecycle events (incl. SessionStart ideate frame-rotation + daily-budget advisory + learn-drain-nudge backlog reminder, SessionEnd ideate-budget capture + ideate-convergence capture via local Ollama embeddings + ideate-memory capture into qmd index + cost-capture token telemetry + learn-capture passive learning-capture default-ON (opt-out) + inferential-structural-judge, post-edit-test async test runner, pr-style-reminder anti-AI-flavor advisory, mcp-session-watchdog auth health on startup/resume, hypothesis-gate investigation gate, ECC-parity ports — fact-force-gate four-fact-force first-edit gate, mcp-health-gate runtime health with exponential backoff + PostToolUseFailure reconnect, dev-tmux-transform dev-server detached-tmux rewrite, context-monitor scope/loop advisory — under a minimal/standard/strict CLAUDE_HOOK_PROFILE ladder per ADR 0007), always-on doctrine injection (METHODOLOGY/RTK/ACLI/DBGATE), the senior-eng output style as the default live-response register, and the staff-eng opt-in register for cross-boundary decisions. Context hierarchy: L1=doctrine/CLAUDE.md, L2=skills on demand, L3=BOUNDARY.md+source via kbg:harness-nav. Components auto-discover from the default agents/, skills/, commands/, hooks/, output-styles/, and themes/ directories.
